newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down, awaiting new finmin.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down, awaiting new finmin.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to decline slightly on Friday as investors awaited for the appointment of new finance minister to succeed Amnuay Viravan who resigned from his post on Thursday, brokers said.
Thai newspapers and political sources said on Friday that Thai Military Bank president Thanong Bidaya was set to be appointed new finance minister on Friday.
"I think investors can accept Thanong if he becomes finance minister to a certain level although he's less well known than Amnuay," said Thaneit Khantigaroon of Ekachart Finance.
Brokers said they believed Thanong had wide knowledge about monetary matters but not on financial issues but time would tell whether he could administer the ministry well or not.
They said the battered market, now at eight year lows, was still on a downtrend on Friday although the index had fallen in the past eight consecutive days.
The composite SET index finished 18.17 points lower at 464.77 on 5.9 billion baht turnover on Thursday. The SET-50 index was down 1.70 points to 31.90.
